prompts.einhandkrieger:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: pixel-art character sprite concept sheet for the existing game Delve Disaster, preview before rigging.
Primary request: ONE consistent cute chibi one-handed sword warrior, six distinct sprites on one sheet. This is the disciplined ordinary warrior, NOT the holy paladin and NOT a barbarian.
Composition: exactly 3 columns x 2 rows, generously spaced identical cells, whole bodies and weapons fully visible, same character scale and foot baseline. Top row: front/south idle, right/east idle, back/north idle. Bottom row: broad one-hand sword slash, precise sword parry with free hand pulled back, ultimate three-cut sword flourish with three separated pale steel crescent trails. Exactly six figures, no extra objects between cells.
Design: large readable face and head, small compact torso, two short visible legs, chunky gloves and boots; simple open-faced blue-steel helmet with a short muted blue crest, sandy hair, visible friendly determined eyes. Blue tabard, brown leather belt, restrained iron shoulders. One straight ordinary steel sword with simple brown grip; empty off hand, NO shield. No giant armor wings. Body and all equipment should be representable on a native 32x32 actor grid; visual sprite height about 28 coarse pixels, enlarged with nearest-neighbor square pixels for inspection. Weapon and combat trails may extend outside the 32px body footprint. Limited palette around 16-24 colors, dark warm near-black outline, 2-3 stepped shades per material, light from upper left. Top-down dungeon RPG three-quarter view; front face visible, not isometric perspective. Deliberately coarse chunky actual pixel clusters, no tiny high-resolution embellishment, no smooth gradients or antialiasing.
Background: genuine transparent alpha. No scenery, ground tiles, contact shadows, grid lines, labels, letters, UI, logos, watermark. All six sprites are unrigged static concept poses, not a continuous animation.
prompts.berserker:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: unrigged pixel-art sprite concept sheet for Delve Disaster, cute top-down chibi dungeon RPG.
Primary request: ONE consistent BERSERKER character in six static poses, clearly different from an armored blue sword knight. Exactly 3 columns x 2 rows of generously spaced complete sprites. Top row: front/south idle, right/east idle, back/north idle. Bottom row: heavy overhead two-handed axe strike, battle roar with axe gripped low, ultimate BERSERK RAGE stance with feet planted wide, lifted axe, a few jagged crimson-orange rage wisps rising off shoulders and bright furious amber eyes. Only last pose has rage energy. No blood or gore.
Design: large expressive cute head, short sturdy body, small visible legs, massive chunky gloves/boots. Wild reddish-brown hair, short beard, exposed muscular forearms, weathered brown fur shoulder mantle, dark iron shoulder on one side, burgundy waist cloth and brown leather harness. NO horned helmet, NO demonic mutation. One large clearly two-handed broad iron battleaxe with short wooden handle, both hands grip same handle in attack poses. Base idle calm but stubborn; raging pose looks physically braced and powerful, same anatomy and same outfit. Axe bigger than the knight's sword, still fully visible and separate from face. Limited 16-24-color palette: iron gray, warm brown fur, deep oxblood cloth, ember accents ONLY for rage.
Style: crisp deliberately COARSE pixel sprites with 32x32 native actor grid as the target, roughly 28 blocky pixels tall, nearest-neighbor enlarged for review. Dark warm outline, strong square pixel clusters, 2-3 stepped shades, short boots and no long adult legs. Top-down RPG front three-quarter view, not isometric. Body resolutions must stay compact; effect trails can extend beyond body footprint. Avoid tiny high-resolution detail, blur, smooth gradients, painterly lighting and glossy illustration.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no painted background, no ground, no grid, no scenery, no text/labels/logo/watermark. Static concept poses only, no rigging. Six figures exactly, equal-scale body silhouettes and baseline.
prompts.paladin:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: six-pose unrigged pixel-art character sprite concept sheet for Delve Disaster.
Primary request: ONE consistent PALADIN, a cute sturdy holy sword-and-shield warrior, visually distinct from a blue ordinary sword knight and a red-haired barbarian. Exactly 3 columns x 2 rows, six complete whole-body sprites with generous clear gaps and consistent body scale and baseline. Top row: front/south idle, right/east idle, back/north idle. Bottom row: holy one-handed sword strike with a short golden arc, kneeling blessing with sword point resting down and small luminous gold ground seal, ultimate SOLAR AEGIS stance with shield planted forward, a clearly separate curved translucent golden barrier and a broken sun-ring over the helmet. Restrained effects only in bottom row; keep shield and face legible.
Design: large friendly readable head, open-faced ivory/silver helmet, visible warm brown eyes, a little dark hair, compact torso, short boots, chunky gloves. Ivory tabard with simple gold sun mark, muted plum cape, silver plate with restrained gold edges. One medium straight one-handed sword, ONE tall broad kite shield bearing a chunky sunburst; shield on left arm, sword in right hand. Raised rim, three simple broad panel areas, readable at small resolution. No oversized angel wings, no floating extra weapons, no cathedral surroundings. The ultimate should look holy and protective, not a fire attack or a full white flash.
Pixel style: coarse crisp square pixel clusters, native actor target 32x32, approximately 28 visible coarse pixels in body height, nearest-neighbor enlarged for review. 16-24-color palette, ivory, warm gold, muted plum, silver, dark warm outlines. Exactly two or three stepped shades per surface. Top-down dungeon RPG three-quarter front view, not isometric; chunky chibi proportions, large eyes, no long adult legs, no smooth painterly gradients, blur, tiny high-resolution detailing, no glossy rendering.
Background: genuine transparent alpha. No background paint, no ground tiles or cast shadows, no grid, no labels, words, logo or watermark. Six distinct static design poses before rigging, not a continuous animation. All weapons, boots, cape and effects fully inside their own cell.
